params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the office's report; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: A chassis number lookup gets stopped at production's 30-second request limit whenever AutoConnect is slow to answer. The dealer then sees nothing at all: no data and no message. On 23 and 24 November nginx logged this for nine vehicles of different garages.

## What happened

A garage in onboarding (Pieteraerens) looked up ZFACF9CA5PU033820 (Fiat) and ZAC5JACL5SJL91514 (Jeep). The lookup ran for a while and then showed nothing. Later the Jeep's draft (24157) carried a handful of fields: make, model, kW, year, colour and transmission. Nothing else was filled in. The Fiat left no trace at all.

Read from production:

- The garage had 19 tokens left, and the Livewire sheet is on for everyone. Neither is the cause.
- VWE answered for the Jeep (code 00, rows 6996 and 6999).
- AutoConnect's lookup answered nothing for the garage's drafts: rows 12350 and 12353 hold `"0"`, which is cURL's `false` saved as text. Each row was written at the same second nginx logged `upstream timed out` for that request.
- The office's own lookup of the same VIN, a minute later and with the same platform key, got 7 blocks at once (12351). So AutoConnect answered intermittently. It does not answer differently per garage.
- No row exists for the Fiat in either provider table. That request was stopped before anything was written.
- nginx logged `createFromVIN` upstream timeouts on 23 and 24 November for 24142, 24143, 24148, 24153, 24157, 24162, 24163, 24164 and 24166, from several different clients.

## Why

On production a web request is stopped after 30 seconds (`request_terminate_timeout`, `max_execution_time` and nginx `fastcgi_read_timeout`, see finding 2026-09-29), and the stopped process writes nothing more. `createFromVIN` makes up to three provider calls inside that one request:

- VWE: a raw socket with no timeout at all.
- AutoConnect: `CURLOPT_TIMEOUT` 30, which on its own is the whole budget.
- CarWizard: `Http::get` with the default timeout of 30 seconds.

When AutoConnect is slow, the request dies before it answers:

- The browser gets a 504 page, which is no JSON.
- What was written before the stop stays: VWE's fields on the draft.
- No token is spent, because the deduction comes last.

That is the "it was there afterwards, but almost empty".

The screen does not show any of this:

- An answer with no JSON leaves the Livewire sheet empty. The classic create and edit pages and the worklist break on `data.responseJSON.errors`, and the worklist never re-enables its button.
- When both providers fail, the 400 carries the AutoConnect reason as a bare string, and the Livewire sheet shows `value[0]`, its first letter.
- With no tokens left, the 400 body is `[]`, and nothing is shown.

Also:

- The kept VWE answer for a VIN is reused for every garage whatever it holds, so one unreadable answer (`false`) stands for that VIN from then on.
- With no connection to VWE, the code runs an `echo` and then writes on `false`, which ends in a 500.

## Expected

- The lookup always answers within the limit, with whatever came back. If VWE answers and AutoConnect does not, the sheet gets VWE's data and the "not everything could be fetched" message.
- Every failure says something: nothing found, no tokens left, or no answer in time (with: reload to see what arrived meanwhile).
params.title: Chassis lookup stopped at the 30-second limit when AutoConnect is slow, and the modal shows nothing
